sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Eshwarappa is a farmer in Chintamani, a town in Karnataka.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: He visits the market regularly to buy seeds for his rice field.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: During one such visit he overheard a conversation between Ramanna and Lakshmamma.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Ramanna said, “Earlier our country had about a lakh varieties of rice.
